notes.title: CyberWhiskey: Guy's Room released on Steam! Future updates detailed here.
notes.notes:
[b]The game finally came out! [/b]Thank you if you played it! I hope it brought you at least a smile or laugh and not too much frustration. I hope you will consider reviewing the game on Steam if you have a couple minutes. It would mean a lot to me as a beginner developer.

I'm already working on the next update for this game, which will bring quality of play changes, bug fixes and steamworks integration. Heres whats coming next:

[list]
[*]Resolve bug when jung interrupts Guy when Guy is interacting with something (causes dialogue display to get wonky for a few seconds)
[*] Easy mode offered after first game over. (offer a mode with no time penalties after first game over)
[*]Add performance settings menu to game on startup.
[*]Fix some typos and make toilet reading easier on eyes.
[/list]

Played the game and have an idea how I could polish it up? Reply here and I'll add it to the list! Ok I'll get back to work.

Thanks, 

Crunch
